newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo aluminium futures firm, helped by strong dlr.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo aluminium futures firm, helped by strong dlr.

text.p: Tokyo yen-based aluminium futures finished higher on Thursday as the dollar's strength against the yen sparked some buying, traders said.
"The market felt relatively strong. The June contract might test the key resistance at 190 yen tomorrow," one trader said.
The dollar's advance to above 116 yen came on top of the metal's gains of $7 to $1,570 per tonne in London overnight, when flagship three months copper ended off $11 at $2,267.

The June contract closed up 1.7 yen at 188.7 yen per kg, while April added 2.2 yen to 190.4 yen. Others ranged from 1.4 to 1.8 yen higher. Estimated volume was 4,357 lots. -- Tokyo Commodities Desk +81-3-3432-6179
